preconditions.description: The number of game pieces n must be between 1 and 500,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= p_i <= 10**9 for p_i in p)
preconditions.description: Each piece's strength p_i must be between 1 and 1,000,000,000.

preconditions.expression: len(team_assignment) == n and all(c in 'AB' for c in team_assignment)
preconditions.description: The team assignment string must have length n and consist only of characters 'A' and 'B'.

postconditions.description: The output must be the maximum strength Bob can achieve as a string.
